text.p: These are the leading stories in the Malawi press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Malawi's paramilitary police in full combat gear have been put on alert to guard High Court judges who recently have been receiving death threats through anonymous telephones and letters.

- Malawi's ruling United Democratic Front party Secretary General Sam Mpasu suing a weekly tabloid, The Democrat, admitted in High Court during cross-examination that he defied the country's Central Bank advice against hiring a UK-based stationery firm.
